page_title: Free Offline PDF Compressor for Mac, Windows, and Linux | FS PDF Compressor

summary.name: FS PDF Compressor
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source desktop app that compresses PDFs locally on your computer using Ghostscript, with no uploads, accounts, or telemetry.
use_cases: Compressing confidential documents without uploading them
Batch compressing a folder of PDFs
Reducing PDF size on Linux via Snap or AppImage
Quick drag-and-drop PDF compression from the desktop
summary.what_it_does: The app compresses PDF files entirely on the local machine using the Ghostscript engine. You can drag in one PDF, several PDFs, or a folder. Compression uses one of three quality profiles (Preserve, Balanced as default, or Maximum) selected from a single menu. Originals are replaced only when the compressed result is smaller. An optional Drop Zone target lets you compress files without reopening the main window.
notable: Fully offline: no account, cloud processing, analytics, or telemetry
Replaces originals only when the result is smaller; Windows moves replaced originals to the Recycle Bin
Optional Drop Zone desktop target and Windows Explorer integration
Signed and notarized macOS app; SHA-256 checksums for Linux and Windows downloads
caveats: Windows installer is currently unsigned, so users must verify its checksum before installing
Windows support is limited to Windows 11 x64; Linux limited to x86_64
On Wayland, the Drop Zone may appear as a normal floating window because the compositor controls placement
